prova:
intro A hA
  obtain ⟨hcard, hdist_eq⟩ := hA
  have hmin : minimalDistinctDistances ℝ² 3 = 1 := by
    have h_opt := erdos_91.test.equiTriangle_optimal
    have hcard_eq : equiTriangle.card = 3 := h_opt.1
    have hdist_eq_min : distinctDistances equiTriangle = minimalDistinctDistances ℝ² 3 := h_opt.2
    have hdist_val : distinctDistances equiTriangle = 1 := by
      unfold distinctDistances distanceSet equiTriangle
      have eucl_dist_one_of_sq : ∀ {x y : ℝ²}, dist x y ^ 2 = 1 → dist x y = 1 := by
        intro x y h; nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := y), sq_nonneg (dist x y)]
      have hd01 : dist (!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0]) (!₂[(1 : ℝ), 0]) = 1 := eucl_dist_one_of_sq <| by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]; simp [Real.dist_eq]
      have hd02 : dist (!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0]) (!₂[(1 : ℝ) / 2, Real.sqrt 3 / 2]) = 1 :=
        eucl_dist_one_of_sq <| by
          rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
          simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (3 : ℝ) ≥ 0 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 3,
            sq_abs ((0 : ℝ) - 1 / 2), sq_abs ((0 : ℝ) - Real.sqrt 3 / 2)]
      have hd12 : dist (!₂[(1 : ℝ), 0]) (!₂[(1 : ℝ) / 2, Real.sqrt 3 / 2]) = 1 :=
        eucl_dist_one_of_sq <| by
          rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
          simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (3 : ℝ) ≥ 0 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 3,
            sq_abs ((1 : ℝ) - 1 / 2), sq_abs ((0 : ℝ) - Real.sqrt 3 / 2)]
      suffices h : ({!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ) / 2, Real.sqrt 3 / 2]} :
          Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image (fun (pair : ℝ² × ℝ²) => dist pair.1 pair.2) = {1} by
        simp only [h, Finset.card_singleton]
      refine Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr
        ⟨⟨!₂[0, 0], !₂[1, 0]⟩, by simp [Finset.mem_offDiag], hd01⟩, fun d hd => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hd
      simp only [Finset.mem_offDiag, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hab
      obtain ⟨ha, hb, _⟩ := hab
      rcases ha with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> first
        | contradiction | exact hd01 | exact hd02 | exact hd12
        | (rw [dist_comm]; first | exact hd01 | exact hd02 | exact hd12)
    rw [← hdist_val, hdist_eq_min]
  have hdist_A : distinctDistances A = 1 := by rw [hdist_eq, hmin]
  have hcard3 : A.card = 3 := hcard
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, hab, hbc, hac, rfl⟩ : ∃ a b c : ℝ², a ≠ b ∧ b ≠ c ∧ a ≠ c ∧ A = {a, b, c} := by
    have ⟨a, s, ha, hs⟩ := Finset.card_eq_succ.mp hcard3
    have ⟨b, t, hb, ht⟩ := Finset.card_eq_succ.mp hs.2
    have ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp ht.2
    have hs_eq : s = {b, c} := by rw [ht.1]
    have ha_not : a ∉ ({b, c} : Finset ℝ²) := by rw [← hs_eq]; exact ha
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at ha_not
    have hb_not : b ∉ ({c} : Finset ℝ²) := by rw [← ht.1]; exact hb
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hb_not
    refine ⟨a, b, c, ha_not.1, hb_not, ha_not.2, by rw [hs.1, ht.1]⟩
  have hd_pos : 0 < dist a b := dist_pos.mpr hab
  set d := dist a b
  have hab_dist : dist a b = d := rfl
  have hbc_dist : dist b c = d := by
    have hmem1 : dist a b ∈ (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2) := by
      simp [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_offDiag, hab]
    have hmem2 : dist b c ∈ (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2) := by
      simp [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_offDiag, hbc]
    have hsingleton : (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2) = {d} := by
      have hcard1 : (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2).card = 1 := hdist_A
      exact Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard1 ▸ by simp [hmem1]
    have h2 : dist b c ∈ ({d} : Finset ℝ) := hsingleton ▸ hmem2
    exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp h2
  have hac_dist : dist a c = d := by
    have hmem1 : dist a b ∈ (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2) := by
      simp [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_offDiag, hab]
    have hmem2 : dist a c ∈ (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2) := by
      simp [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_offDiag, hac]
    have hsingleton : (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2) = {d} := by
      have hcard1 : (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2).card = 1 := hdist_A
      exact Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard1 ▸ by simp [hmem1]
    have h2 : dist a c ∈ ({d} : Finset ℝ) := hsingleton ▸ hmem2
    exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp h2
  have hd_eq_one : d = 1 := by
    have hmem01 : dist (!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0]) (!₂[(1 : ℝ), 0]) = 1 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]; simp [Real.dist_eq]
    have h_tri_dist : equiTriangle.offDiag.image (fun p => dist p.1 p.2) = {1} := by
      unfold equiTriangle
      have eucl_dist_one_of_sq : ∀ {x y : ℝ²}, dist x y ^ 2 = 1 → dist x y = 1 := by
        intro x y h; nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := y), sq_nonneg (dist x y)]
      have hd02 : dist (!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0]) (!₂[(1 : ℝ) / 2, Real.sqrt 3 / 2]) = 1 :=
        eucl_dist_one_of_sq <| by
          rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
          simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (3 : ℝ) ≥ 0 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 3,
            sq_abs ((0 : ℝ) - 1 / 2), sq_abs ((0 : ℝ) - Real.sqrt 3 / 2)]
      have hd12 : dist (!₂[(1 : ℝ), 0]) (!₂[(1 : ℝ) / 2, Real.sqrt 3 / 2]) = 1 :=
        eucl_dist_one_of_sq <| by
          rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
          simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (3 : ℝ) ≥ 0 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 3,
            sq_abs ((1 : ℝ) - 1 / 2), sq_abs ((0 : ℝ) - Real.sqrt 3 / 2)]
      refine Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr
        ⟨⟨!₂[0, 0], !₂[1, 0]⟩, by simp [Finset.mem_offDiag], hmem01⟩, fun x hx => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨⟨p1, p2⟩, hp, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_offDiag, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hp
      obtain ⟨hp1, hp2, _⟩ := hp
      rcases hp1 with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hp2 with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> first
        | contradiction | exact hmem01 | exact hd02 | exact hd12
        | (rw [dist_comm]; first | exact hmem01 | exact hd02 | exact hd12)
    have hmem_tri : dist (!₂[0, 0]) (!₂[1, 0]) ∈ equiTriangle.offDiag.image (fun p => dist p.1 p.2) := by
      simp [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_offDiag, equiTriangle]
    have h1_in : (1 : ℝ) ∈ ({1} : Finset ℝ) := Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
    have h1_eq : dist (!₂[0, 0]) (!₂[1, 0]) = 1 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]; simp [Real.dist_eq]
    have h_d_in : d ∈ ({d} : Finset ℝ) := Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
    have h_d_in_tri : d ∈ equiTriangle.offDiag.image (fun p => dist p.1 p.2) := by
      have hmem_A : d ∈ ({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image (fun p => dist p.1 p.2) := by
        simp [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_offDiag, hab]
      have h_A_eq : ({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image (fun p => dist p.1 p.2) = {d} := by
        have hcard1 : (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image (fun p => dist p.1 p.2)).card = 1 := hdist_A
        exact Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard1 ▸ by simp [hmem_A]
      rw [← h_A_eq, hdist_eq, hmin] at h_tri_dist
      -- since both sets are equal to {1}, d must be 1
      exact h_tri_dist ▸ h_d_in
    have h_d_val : d ∈ ({1} : Finset ℝ) := h_tri_dist ▸ h_d_in_tri
    exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp h_d_val
  use DilationEquiv.refl ℝ²
  simp [equiTriangle, hA]
